# Utility tools

Read with `docs/02-tool-framework.md`. All run in the browser.

---

### U01 · QR Code Generator — `qr-code-generator`
**Does:** QR codes for URL, text, Wi-Fi (SSID/password/security), vCard contact, email, phone, SMS.
**Controls:** content type + fields, error correction (L/M/Q/H, default M; H automatically when a logo is added), size, margin, foreground/background colour (with a contrast warning if scanning may fail), optional centre logo (local file, stays in browser), dot/eye style (square/rounded).
**Output:** PNG (up to 4096 px), SVG (generated by us — clean, no scripts), and copy-to-clipboard.
**Behaviour:** static QR codes only (no redirect tracking) — say "Your QR code never expires and doesn't track scans".
**Tests:** generated codes decode (jsQR or ZXing in test) to the exact input for each content type, including with logo at H.
**SEO:** "qr code generator" · "free qr code generator no expiry", "wifi qr code generator".

### U02 · Batch Rename Files — `batch-rename`
**Does:** Rename many files with rules: prefix/suffix, counter (start, step, padding), find & replace (plain or regex), change case, insert date (today or EXIF/creation date from media), remove characters, change extension (with warning).
**Behaviour:**
- Chromium desktop: with the File System Access API the user can pick a folder and rename **in place** (after a preview and explicit confirm; undo list kept for the session).
- Other browsers: renamed copies downloaded as a ZIP.
- Live preview table (old → new), conflict detection (duplicate names), nothing touches disk before confirm.
**Flags:** `desktopBest`.
**Tests:** rule chain on 100 fixture names produces expected names; duplicates flagged; EXIF-date rule uses capture date.
**SEO:** "batch rename files online" · "bulk rename files", "rename photos by date".

### U03 · Print Size & DPI Calculator — `dpi-calculator`
**Does:** Pixels ↔ print size at a DPI (cm, mm, inches), required pixels for a print size at 150/300 DPI, "max print size at acceptable quality" for an image (drop an image to fill its pixel size), paper presets (A-series, US Letter, photo sizes).
**Tests:** 3000×2000 at 300 DPI → 25.4 × 16.93 cm.
**SEO:** "dpi calculator" · "pixels to cm", "image print size calculator".

### U04 · File Checksum — `file-checksum` (Wave 3)
MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 of files (streamed, handles multi-GB); compare two files or a file against a pasted hash; batch list export. For verifying media offloads/copies. **SEO:** "checksum calculator online", "sha256 file hash".
